about: Parity oracle for the personal email model email-v1 (contract section 4). Written by saqr/intel/user_model.py; consumed by tests/test_user_model.py and the JS twin (extension/lib/email_features.js + user_model.js). features[]: input -> sorted feature strings + sorted unique buckets (exact). predict[]: features(input) then predict(model, features, input.from_address) -> p_scam (tolerance 1e-9; null = not available). strings[] is sorted by code point (Python order; JS sort() orders astral chars differently) - compare it as a SET. Token length is in CODE POINTS (Array.from(t).length in JS, not t.length). Settled where the contract is silent: an address's host is the text after its LAST '@' (inside <...> if present), trimmed + lowercased, '' if no '@'; rd:none when the reply-to has no domain; regdom trims and drops all trailing dots; empty flag codes skipped; an empty/whitespace from_address is not a sender (train skips it, predict adds no prior); trim = JS String.trim(). Extra sections train[] and merge[] compare models without updated_at.

features.note: Arabic harakat (Mn) are NOT \p{L}: they split words; tatweel U+0640 is Lm so it stays inside
Persian ZWNJ U+200C is stripped (joins the word); Arabic-Indic and Extended digits are \p{N}
mixed script: Cyrillic a (U+0430) inside PayPal stays as-is (no confusable folding); Cyrillic A in display name
emoji: pictographs, ZWJ family, flag (regional indicators), keycap, skin tone are all separators
NON-BMP: astral letters count as ONE code point each (JS String.length counts 2). 1 Gothic letter = dropped (JS .length 2!), 2 = kept, 30 = kept (JS .length 60), 31 = dropped
NON-BMP case mapping: Deseret capitals (U+10400..) lowercase to U+10428..; CJK Ext-B ideographs
NFKC: mathematical bold letters (astral) fold to plain Latin
NFKC: fullwidth letters + ideographic space U+3000; halfwidth katakana with dakuten
NFKC: ligatures ﬁ ﬂ ﬀ ﬃ expand BEFORE the length check (29 cp + ﬃ = 31 -> dropped; 27 + ﬃ = 30 kept)
NFKC: roman numerals, circled digits, superscripts, squared units, Kelvin sign, ㍿
invisible chars in the strip set join the word: ZWSP, soft hyphen, word joiner, BOM, ZWJ, CGJ, LRM, RLO
invisible chars NOT in the strip set: NBSP (NFKC space), Mongolian vowel sep U+180E (Cf), line sep U+2028, Hangul filler U+3164 (a LETTER: NFKC -> U+1160)
token length bounds: 1, 2, 30, 31 code points (ASCII), invisibles stripped before counting
Greek final sigma on lowercase; Turkish dotted I lowercases to i + U+0307 (Mn) which splits; sharp s
CJK and Japanese runs are one token each (no spaces in the script)

3-label regdoms: co.uk, gov.ae, com.sa; uppercase + ONE trailing dot stripped; bare suffix
freemail: subdomain of gmail.com and uppercase count; gmail.co.uk is not on the list; reply_to same regdom
reply_to different regdom (freemail reply to a brand sender)
reply_to empty string -> rd:none; from has no @ -> NO domain ("fd:", fx:0)
reply_to without @ has no domain -> rd:none
"Name <addr>" form: the address inside <> is used; surrounding whitespace (incl. BOM, NBSP) trimmed; host lowercased
several trailing dots are dropped; whitespace inside the host part is trimmed
empty and null flag codes are skipped; non-list link_domains / flags are ignored
from_address with two @ -> host = text after the LAST @
IDN sender in Unicode and in punycode; localhost (single label)
more than 20 link_domains: only the first 20 entries are used (duplicates and an empty entry still use a slot; "" -> "ld:")
more than 300 body tokens: one-letter words do not count, repeats DO count toward the first 300
auth: partial dict, null and empty values -> "none"; other values copied as-is
auth: not_checked values; flags duplicated (set semantics)
display name containing an e-mail address and a different real sender
lone surrogate in a link domain: hashed as U+FFFD (what JS TextEncoder does)
whitespace variety: tabs, CRLF, NBSP, narrow NBSP U+202F, thin space; uppercase kept lowercase
